type Tree = Tree[];
type Nested = Array<Nested>;
type Frozen = readonly Frozen[];
type List = [number, List?];
type Table = Map<string, Table>;
type Boxed = { value: number }[] | Boxed[];
interface Box<T> {
  value: T;
}
type Chain = Box<Chain | undefined>;

const tree: Tree = [[], [[]]];
const nested: Nested = [[[]]];
const frozen: Frozen = [[], []];
const list: List = [1, [2, [3]]];
const table: Table = new Map([["a", new Map()]]);
const boxed: Boxed = [[{ value: 1 }]];
const chain: Chain = { value: { value: undefined } };

function depth(t: Tree): number {
  return t.length === 0 ? 0 : 1 + Math.max(...t.map(depth));
}
function sum(l: List): number {
  return l[0] + (l[1] ? sum(l[1]) : 0);
}
const other: Nested = tree;
console.log(tree, depth(tree), depth(other), nested.length, frozen.length);
console.log(sum(list), table.get("a")?.size, boxed.length, chain.value?.value);
